name: query_client_brain
description: Query a single client's self-updating context store (emails, notes, prior-matter documents) plus, optionally, firm-wide knowledge. Enforces per-client access grants, conflict-of-interest isolation, and visibility (lawyer_only vs lawyer_and_client) before returning anything.

requester_user_id.description: Caller's user_id. Determines role (lawyer/paralegal/client/admin) and, via client_access, whether they may see this client's brain at all.

client_id.description: The client whose mini-brain is being queried.

query.description: Free-text query. Matched against ingested document title/body.

include_firm_wide.description: Whether to also search firm-wide (non-client-confidential) knowledge and return it as a clearly separate block.

denial_reason.description: Populated only when allowed=false. One of: unknown_user, unknown_client, no_active_grant, conflict_wall.

client_results.description: Matches from this client's own mini-brain, already filtered by visibility for the requester's role. Empty (not omitted) when allowed=false.

firm_wide_results.description: Matches from firm-wide knowledge, kept in a separate array so a caller can never mistake generic firm knowledge for this client's confidential context.
